notes.title: Beardy McStrongarm Free-To-Play Announcement
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce that I will be making Beardy McStrongarm free to download and keep on steam!

It has now been over 5 years since I started the development of Beardy McStrongarm and over 4 years since the game launched. It was my first game to launch on steam and I learned a lot while developing it. I feel like I have grown significantly as a game developer and I don't feel like the game is worthy enough to keep behind a paywall so I made the decision to transfer it to free-to-play. 

I wanted to make this announcement to warn anyone who is interested in the game to not buy the game and just wait for it to transition to free-to-play.

-Blekoh

notes.title: Linux Update
notes.notes:
With the recent release of Game Maker Studio 2.3, Linux build support was finally fixed. The new patch for Beardy McStrongarm updates the Linux version of the game.

These updates include:
[list]
[*]Performance Improvements
[*]Bug Fixes
[*]Updated menu screen for Fullscreen/Window switching
[/list]

Thanks for playing Beardy McStrongarm,

Blekoh
